_comment: Search terms for the article discovery job (discover-articles.js / .php). Both scripts read this file fresh on every run, so edit it freely without touching code. Google News search syntax: quoted phrases, OR groups in parentheses, when:7d for recency.
_facilityKeywordsComment: OR-group appended to every per-facility Google News query: "<facility name>" "<state>" (kw OR kw ...). Keep to short stems; Google News caps query length.
_facilityRecencyComment: Google News when: filter for per-facility queries. Relevance sorting otherwise surfaces years-old coverage. Empty string disables.
_topicQueriesComment: Topic-level queries run before the per-facility loop (they replace the old Google Alerts). boost is added to the candidate score ONLY when one of the match phrases appears in the headline or blurb (Google News relevance matching is loose: without this, 'troubled teen industry' returned artist profiles and obituaries). Threshold is 3; a strong title keyword adds 3, a weak one 2, a facility match 2. boost 3 = accept on the phrase alone; boost 2 = phrase plus a keyword or facility; boost 1 = phrase plus a strong or weak title keyword (not a description keyword alone). Match phrases are plain substrings with no word boundaries, so keep them specific ("juvenile detention", not "juvenile"). when: overrides topicRecency.
_maxTopicSubmissionsComment: Cap on topic-query candidates submitted per run (0 = no cap). Protects the Groq rate limit on the first nights, when the seen-URL cache has not caught up with the 7-day topic window. Candidates over the cap are left unmarked and picked up on a later run if still in the feed.

_genericQueryNamesComment: Facility names too generic to search on their own. Google News is skipped for these (they still match by alias in Reddit/topic candidates). Add names that keep showing up as facilityQuery in the rejected log with low-score results. Compared case-insensitively after stripping punctuation. Aliases shared by 3+ facilities are skipped automatically.
_ignoreAliasesComment: Names that must never count as a facility match or be searched on their own. For facility records whose name is not a real place name (a record literally named "Kansas" turned every Kansas City crime story into a facility hit). Bare US state names are ignored automatically. Compared case-insensitively after stripping punctuation.
_redditComment: Every link posted to r/troubledteens (link posts and links inside text posts) is submitted without scoring: the subreddit is the filter. Only reddit-internal, social and video hosts and PDFs are skipped, because the AI stage has nothing to extract from them.
